name: Morning briefing
caption: 08:30: the digest job hands the day's threat intel to Claude Cowork and writes the returned briefing to local files. 08:45: n8n's internal cron picks them up, renders HTML, and hands it to Resend. It lands in the work inbox. The only flow that leaves the house and comes back.

name: Task from Discord
caption: A message arrives on Discord and reaches Hermes, which routes it to the workspace as MCP sender and on to OpenCode. Four subagents fan out and work through llama-swap, Mnemosyne is read and written, the run is traced to Langfuse, and the result returns to Discord.

name: Model swap
caption: A task needs imagery. llama-swap unloads Qwen from the GPU, holds nothing, loads the diffusion model, ComfyUI generates, and the group returns to Qwen. One model resident at a time — the constraint enforced, not described.

name: Health sweep
caption: cron fires its scheduled checks and triggers maintenance, and the metrics land in Grafana.

name: Off-network access
caption: A phone joins the tailnet from anywhere and reaches Hermes. Nothing is exposed publicly, no ports open.
